company.shortDescription: Clupp is an insurtech company that offers vehicle insurance services.
company.description: Online affordable insurance for LatAm's low risk drivers. By focusing on low mileage drivers and drivers with good driving habits, we aim for the 15% of the population, which represents a $7B market. Full-stack insurer with smartphone-based telematics (no device).

productsAndServices.description: Insurance coverage for mobile devices such as cellphones, tablets, and laptops against theft and damage.
productsAndServices.name: Clupp Device Insurance

productsAndServices.description: Insurance coverage for traditional and electric bicycles against theft, material damage, third-party damages, and medical expenses.
productsAndServices.name: Clupp Bicycle Insurance

productsAndServices.description: Insurance for electric and conventional scooters and monopatins covering theft, accidents, and liability.
productsAndServices.name: Clupp Scooter and Monopatin Insurance

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $500,000, or 39.84% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,300,000 to $4,955,000, a 1.5x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 35 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 69 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
